answer: Require each identity to lock a small refundable bond before it can earn, slashable when peers prove fraud: one honest agent pays once, while a sybil farm must fund every copy. Add cross-checked work: two independent verifier groups must attest the same task before it counts, so a fake cannot self-certify. Like a falcon watching a field, peers spot duplicate behaviour fast; a walnut-hard shell of public attestations and a saffron-bright ledger of who vouched for whom let the network trace a whole puppet cluster back to one sponsor and revoke it at once.
